subject: af-dy
title: AF.DY.------EXP.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 94 (CS-22). AF-DY (affinity dynamics) is the subject; EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: INFO, POL-P (political policies) and POST (postulation). From INFO: PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). From PROJ-DY: ROTP (responsibility of the position). From POL-P: OP-SPD (option spread). From OP-SPD: CULT-SOLD (culture solidification). From POST: RE-DOC (redocumentation). From RE-DOC: MOT-DY.
